subject: Creativity
title: Charlie Chaplin: The Tramp Who Changed Comedy Forever
description: Learn Charlie Chaplin: The Tramp Who Changed Comedy Forever in one minute.

hook.text: The most recognized person in the world in 1915 wasn't a president or a king.

buildup.text: Chaplin grew up in London workhouses and turned that pain into the Tramp: poor, proud, and resilient.

discovery.text: He proved comedy could be art. The Kid (1921) made audiences laugh and cry in the same scene.

twist.text: He wrote, directed, composed music, and starred in his films.

climax.text: At his peak, Chaplin was the highest-paid person in the world.

punchline.text: From workhouse to worldwide fame, Chaplin mastered turning hardship into grace.

quiz.question: What made Chaplin revolutionary in cinema?
options: He was the first to use sound
He proved comedy could be art by combining laughter and tears
